documents.title: Sebastian County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 289 pages. Amounts are the Budget Summary by Fund/Department (book pp. 17-19 = PDF pp. 21-23), each category column and 'Total'; fund amounts from the '2026 Requested' column of the 2026 Fund Summary Comparison (p. 5), which equals the summary table and the worksheets' '2026 Adopted Budget' (e.g. County Judge $550,307 on p. 92) column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
